decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The noise generated from the air condenser unit should be inaudible when assessed from the nearest noise sensitive receptor

Condition : 4 - The noise emitted from the air condenser unit, shall not be less than 10dB9A) below the existing background noise levels (Laeq), when measured from the nearest noise sensitive receptor, over any 24 hour period.
description: Modification to HVAC system including new ducting on North West facade and new air handling unit to the roof of the building.
